clues: Whoever carried the lantern is younger than whoever carried the ladder.
The visitor with the rope is older than the one with the ladder.
Of Milo and the visitor carrying the rope, one is 60 years old and the other is 40.
The visitor who claimed to be fishing is exactly 30 years older than the one who claimed to be sketching.
Whoever gave the fishing excuse is older than whoever brought the wrench.
Boris said he had been either jogging or sketching.
Of Cass and the visitor with the fishing excuse, one is 20 years old and the other is 60.
Jade's excuse was neither fishing nor stargazing.
Of the visitor who claimed to be jogging and the 50-year-old, one is Arlo and the other is Cass.
hints: Look at the fishing excuse in the box where excuses meet ages. How old could that visitor possibly be?
Two clues together. Clue 4's 30-year gap and clue 7's pair each limit the fishing visitor's age. Which age do both allow?
So the fishing excuse goes with 60. By clue 7, Cass is 20, and by clue 4 the sketching excuse is 30.
Cass is not 50, so by clue 9 Arlo is 50 and Cass gave the jogging excuse. Clues 6 and 8 then leave only Milo for fishing.

solution.key_idea: Clue 4 allows the fishing excuse only 50 or 60, and clue 7 only 20 or 60, so the fishing excuse is 60.
steps: By clue 4, the fishing excuse is 50 or 60; by clue 7, it is 20 or 60. So it is 60.
By clue 7, Cass is 20. By clue 4, the sketching excuse is 30.
Cass is not 50, so by clue 9 Arlo is 50 and Cass gave the jogging excuse. By clue 6, Boris was sketching, at 30.
Arlo is 50, and clue 8 keeps Jade off fishing, so Milo was fishing, at 60. Jade, at 40, gave the lost dog excuse (clue 8); Arlo was stargazing.
Milo is 60, so by clue 3 the rope is 40: Jade carried it.
The ladder is younger than Jade's rope (clue 2) but older than the lantern (clue 1). So the ladder is 30 and the lantern 20.
So Boris carried the ladder and Cass the lantern. Clue 5 keeps the wrench off 60, so Arlo had it and Milo the crowbar.
solution.epilogue: Boris had climbed up to sketch the whale and found its tail hanging by one rivet, so he carried it home to mend. He brought it back on Friday, and Felix pronounced it shipshape.

answer_line: Boris took down the copper whale, using the ladder.
